sentences.text: Shri Himanshu Bhargava, counsel for the appellant.
Ms. Bhagyashree Gupta, G.A. for respondent/State.
Heard on admission.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
Also heard on I.A.No.553/2024 which is application for suspension of jail sentence on behalf of appellant Dashrath Nagar.

Appellant have been convicted by the trial court under sections 420 of IPC and under section 6(1) of M.P. Nikshepkon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000 and sentenced to undergo 5 years RI with fine of Rs.2,000/- and 5 years SI with fine of Rs.50,000/- with default stipulation.

entities.text: M.P. Nikshepkon Ke Hiton Ka Sanrakshan Adhiniyam, 2000
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2 . As per prosecution case, complainant Bahadur Singh presented a written application to the Superintendent of Police Agar against the present appellant and other accused persons that the accused persons are defrauding the public by holding the post of Director.
It does the business of selling plots or taking cash in lumpsum or in installments along with fixed interest amount from the said company.
The applicant who is farmer paid lumpsum cash of Rs.41,40,000/- to the said organization on 24.4.2013 through the organization's authorized agent Gangaram.
Two and one payment plan of Rs.Four Lacs for 6 years, Rs.40 Lacs and Rs.18 Lacs was received.
The accused company had given him refund cheques of the said amount maturity from 2014 to 2019, out o f which two cheques of the year 2015 of Rs.7 Lac 20 thousand each were given to HDFC Bank.

Both the said cheques were dishonoured on 4.8.2015 and when he contacted Chairman Ambaram Nagar and Manager Subhash Sharma and others of the accused company, they showed reluctance and did not give him the money till the date of report.
In this regard he presented a chargesheet under section 138 of N.I. Act but the accused are deliberately not taking the notice and have disappeared after closing the Dewas office.
Thereafter police has registered a case against the present appellants under section 420, 120-B of IPC.

sentences.text: Counsel for the appellant submits that complainant Bahadur Singh (PW-1) has deposed that the main accused was Gangaram who had pursuaded him to deposit Rs.1,70,000/- with company giving allurement of double of the money.
He has not made any allegation against the present appellant.
From the testimony of complainant PW-1 and from the record it is evident that Gangaram played role of agent and persuaded the complainant to deposit the amount.
One of the co-accused Ambaram was Managing Director of the company.
It is informed that he has already died.
4. Counsel for the State submits that appellants are Directors of the company and they were also part of the conspiracy.
5. From perusal of record, it is evident that policy was signed by co- accused Subhash Sharma.
Prima facie there is no direct allegation against the appellant.
No financial transaction is made in his personal account.
Appellant was on bail during trial and he did not misuse the liberty, final hearing of the appeal is likely to take time.
Considering the aforesaid, I.A.No.553/2024 is allowed and jail sentence of the appellant- Dashrath Nagar shall remain suspended.

6. It is directed that subject to depositing the fine amount, if already not deposited, the appellant shall be released on bail, on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lac only) alongwith a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Trial Court, for his appearance before the Registry of this Court firstly on 23.4.2024 and on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Registry in this regard, till final disposal of this appeal.
C.c. as per rules.
